title: Spectral analysis of the logit mapping and implications for stochastic user equilibrium algorithms
summary: We analyze the Jacobian of the logit mapping for stochastic user equilibrium (SUE) and use it to develop two improved algorithms for path-based SUE. We show that the Jacobian decomposes into two matrices: one that annihilates differences of feasible path flow vectors, and another whose eigenvalues are all non-positive reals, provided link costs are monotone non-decreasing and separable.
